preconditions.description: The number of operations of adding a vertex is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Each line of the input contains a valid operation description
preconditions.description: Each operation is described by a line with an integer k and up to 2k space-separated integers.

preconditions.expression: The sum of all k across all operations does not exceed 10^5
preconditions.description: The total number of edges to be added does not exceed 10^5.

preconditions.expression: The graph remains acyclic and does not have multiple edges after each operation
preconditions.description: The graph remains a forest after each operation.

postconditions.expression: The output is a single integer
postconditions.description: The result is a single integer representing the sum of the weights of all edges in the resulting graph modulo 10^9 + 7.

invariants.description: The graph starts with no vertices or edges.
Each new vertex is added after all previous vertices have been added.

invariants.expression: Edges are added from the root of each specified vertex
invariants.description: Each new edge is added from the root of the specified vertex to the new vertex with a weight calculated as the depth of the root vertex plus the specified weight.

invariants.expression: The sum of weights of all edges is calculated modulo 10^9 + 7
invariants.description: The final result is the sum of the weights of all edges modulo 10^9 + 7.
